name: Records

entrances.note: Arrival through Orientation's east door; the whole west edge of the annex (x 0, rows 6-10) is the open edge, as the kit's Records room treats its entrance.

exits.note: Walk off the west edge to return to Orientation. The way back is open from the first minute; only the repair door beyond it is locked.

elevator.note: Records stop of the shared elevator, in the annex before the repair door, so the elevator always returns to unlocked districts. The Systems stop appears after level 11.

light_states.description: Shelf-end lamps and the chute lamp wake as the repair door opens (levels.md 07: shelf-end lights change).
Both ends of the ledger light (levels.md 09: correct margins light both ends).
The luminous ceiling ring lights its floor pool and the four ring lamps pulse (levels.md 11).

changes.note: Landmark after state: folders regain colour, ring glow, ledger stamped, lamps pulse.

ambient: Paper handling, drawer runners, subdued room tone. Labels regain distinct colors and the hidden corridor becomes walkable (levels.md World and art rules).

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Repair a misfiled minute by selecting the wrong clause exactly and typing the original, with no clock.
success_criteria: The minute reads 'The route to the annex was approved on Monday by request.'
The selection covered only the wrong clause

task.prompt: Noor's minute book has one misfiled sentence. Select the wrong clause with Shift and Caps navigation and type the original clause.

document.text: The route to the annex was changed on Monday without request.
document.target: The route to the annex was approved on Monday by request.

targets.text: The route to the annex was approved on Monday by request.

rejects: a letter typed while Caps is held

feedback.held: A letter was pressed while Caps was held and became a command. Release Caps to type text.

task.layout: No keyboard diagram; no clock; retry any time.

dialogue.speaker: noor
dialogue.text: One sentence in the minute book is misfiled. Repair it exactly, in your own time.

dialogue.speaker: noor
dialogue.text: That is the minute as it was written. Take the bookmark.

reward.note: Accuracy only; no clock, no seal, no required skill.

pace_signs.text: Address accepted along the approved route.
Summary: the first and last sections were not reviewed.

notes: Size: 36 x 16 cells (two screens joined: the 20-cell camera view scrolls across the archive).

Layout: annex (entrance, elevator, repair-door panel) west; the repair door opens onto a foyer and the ring around the circular desk; the log room (08) is the south-west branch, the margin room (09) the north-west branch behind crooked cabinets, the gallery (10) above the hub behind a parked ladder, the review chamber (11) at the far east end, and Mira's chute pocket on the south-east, joined to the chamber by the sliding file wall.
